name: surface
description: Holds edits and commits until Claude can state their consequences, and makes it ask you when it can't

ignore_paths.title: Ignored paths
ignore_paths.description: Comma-separated path fragments the gate never holds (scratch, notes, plans)

allow_new_files.title: Free new files
allow_new_files.description: Let Claude create a file that does not exist yet without declaring it

gate_shell_edits.title: Gate shell edits
gate_shell_edits.description: Also hold sed -i, perl -i and > redirects into existing files

reset_on_prompt.title: Reset on each message
reset_on_prompt.description: Clearances end when you send a new message, so each instruction gets its own declaration
